name: bakery-v1
prompt: Create a standalone game-asset reference of ONLY the bakery from the top middle of the supplied design sheet. Preserve its beautiful cream walls, coral rounded tile roof, teal-and-cream striped awning and chunky painted-toy forms. One complete isolated building, elevated three-quarter front view, whole roof and shallow cream foundation visible, pure white background with no horizon and no cast shadow outside the footprint. Important functional change: the big recessed display window and its broad counter must be EMPTY, no bread/food in the window, on the counter, or in the oven. A small dark oven alcove on the right side is visible and empty, no flame, no light. Bakery with one entrance door, no words, no signs, no other buildings, no people, no separate plants or garden. Large smooth forms, mobile game-friendly detail, thick rounded trim and shallow solid window surfaces instead of transparent glass. Soft neutral lighting, no dramatic shading, nothing cropped. This is exactly one building for image-to-3D.

name: baker-v1
prompt: Create a standalone game-asset reference of ONLY the friendly baker from the top middle of the supplied character sheet. Preserve the same face, white rounded baker hat, short brown hair, cream shirt, coral apron, slate trousers, rounded brown shoes and toy proportions. Full body including feet, isolated centered on pure white, no ground, no cast shadow, no pedestal. Show front three-quarter view with minimal perspective, friendly closed-mouth smile. Neutral relaxed A-pose for a 3D character: both empty arms angled about 25 degrees away from torso, hands simple rounded shapes, clear gap at armpits, feet separated shoulder-width, toes point forward. Hat firmly attached, no thin hanging accessories, no bread or utensils. Beautiful softly sculpted painted plastic, satin finish with restrained highlights, clean neutral studio light, big readable smooth forms with limited surface detail. Exactly one baker, no other characters, no text.

name: grandma-v1
prompt: Create a standalone game-asset reference of ONLY the kind grandmother from the top left of the supplied character sheet. Preserve her friendly face, silver bun, simple round glasses close to her face, lavender cardigan over teal dress, coral shoes, soft rounded toy proportions. Full body including feet, isolated centered on pure white, no ground or cast shadow, no pedestal. Front three-quarter view with minimal perspective. Neutral A-pose suitable for humanoid rigging: both empty arms angled 25 degrees away from torso, clean gap at armpits, simple rounded hands. Legs separated shoulder-width, both shoes visibly separate, lower legs exposed below a simple knee-length dress; keep skirt modest and narrow enough to leave leg motion visible. No cane, bag, props, thin floating accessories or articulated fingers. Beautiful sculpted painted-toy plastic, satin-to-matte, subtle highlights, neutral studio light. Exactly one grandmother, no other characters, no text.

name: asphalt-v1
prompt: A seamless repeating square base-color texture tile of clean smooth asphalt for a beautiful children's miniature toy-town 3D game. Orthographic straight top-down, texture fills every pixel edge to edge. Uniform medium slate gray with a restrained warm undertone, approximately #747b7e, low contrast and subtle tiny rounded grain, softly hand-painted / molded toy surface, NOT a photograph. Calm readable surface so bright toy cars and white road markings stand out. Perfectly even flat ambient color, no directional lighting, no vignette, no shadows, no large patches, no cracks, no debris, no pebbles larger than a few pixels, no road markings, no borders, no text. Edges must repeat seamlessly on all four sides, no distinct recognizable motif. Square image.

name: paving-v1
prompt: A seamless repeating square base-color texture tile of a tidy warm ivory stone sidewalk for a children's miniature toy-town 3D game. Orthographic straight top-down, full-bleed edge to edge. Exactly a regular 4 by 4 grid of large square softly rounded pale warm-gray/ivory paving slabs, extremely subtle per-slab tone variation, narrow low-contrast beige-gray joints. Joint centerlines at the outside canvas borders so repetitions join correctly into an even grid; each of the four rows and four columns has the same tile pitch. Material is sculpted painted-toy stone, clean and pleasantly smooth, not photorealistic. Gentle almost-flat surface relief suggested by minimal local edge shading, but NO overall lighting gradient, no directional cast shadows, no vignette, no decorative pattern, no cracks, no dirt, no flowers, no markings, no text. Quiet low-contrast finish; the slabs must not compete with game objects. Edges repeat seamlessly in both directions. Square image.

name: paving-v2
prompt: Edit this paving texture into ONE seamless square paving-stone tile, not a grid. The whole image must contain exactly ONE large square ivory stone slab, extending to the image boundaries, viewed orthographically straight down. Preserve the beautiful subtle warm ivory painted-toy stone color and gentle surface texture of the reference. Remove all internal rows and columns. Along each of the FOUR outer edges include only HALF of a very narrow beige-gray grout joint, equal width on every side, so repeating the image creates uniform joints. The slab covers about 98% of the width and height; the half-joint gutter is about 1% each side. No outside border or padding. Very gently rounded corners with tiny local bevel shading, flat neutral illumination, no overall light gradient, no vignette, no cast shadow, no cracks or decorative marks, no text. Opposite edges must match perfectly. One uniform slab per image is essential, to avoid a thicker seam every fourth slab when tiled.
